request.text:
A range of this kind is conditional on the listed inputs.
\Cref{sec:p15-w02b-p15-073} works a lane-capacity estimate with input
ranges and exhibits an omitted variable, vehicle length divided by speed,
that moves the target outside the stated range by more than an order of
magnitude in slow traffic.
